items.title: 以页面宽度为基准
items.text: 显示的 px 数 = rpx 数 × 页面显示宽度 ÷ 750。基准是页面宽度，不是屏幕上有多少物理像素。

items.title: 尺寸变化后仍要检查内容
items.text: 留白和按钮宽度可以按比例适配，长文字与分栏还需要换行和重排。要在实际设备宽度上检查阅读与操作。

modules.title: 把 px 全换成 rpx，就适配了吗
modules.text: 把所有 px 都换成 rpx 不能保证布局合适。文字大小、点击面积和更宽设备上的显示都要单独检查。

lessonPractice.title: 页面从 375px 变宽到 450px，一条色块设为 width: 750rpx。它会怎样变化？

options.label: 变成 450px，仍铺满页面宽度
options.feedback: 750rpx 代表整页宽度，显示长度会跟着页面宽度变化。

options.label: 保持 375px，旁边会多出空白
options.feedback: 这是固定 375px 的表现，750rpx 会按页面宽度换算。

options.label: 变成屏幕上 750 个物理像素
options.feedback: rpx 的基准是页面宽度，不能按物理像素数量理解。

en.title: A page grows from 375px to 450px wide. A strip uses width: 750rpx. What happens?

options.label: It grows to 450px and still spans the page
options.feedback: 750rpx represents full page width, so its displayed width follows the page.

options.label: It remains 375px, leaving room beside it
options.feedback: That is the behavior of a fixed 375px length, not 750rpx.

options.label: It becomes 750 physical pixels on the display
options.feedback: rpx is based on page width; it is not a count of physical pixels.

items.title: Page width is the reference
items.text: Displayed CSS pixels = rpx value × page width in CSS pixels ÷ 750. The reference is page width, not physical pixel density.

items.title: Keep content readable
items.text: Scaling margins and widths can help. Long labels and columns still need wrapping and layout decisions at actual device widths.

modules.title: Does replacing every px with rpx make the layout fit?
modules.text: Replacing every px value with rpx does not guarantee a good layout. Text size, touch areas, and wider screens require checking separately.

distinctions.label: px
distinctions.text: A fixed CSS pixel length does not convert with page width as rpx does. CSS pixels are not physical device pixels.

distinctions.label: Responsive layout
distinctions.text: Changes arrangement when space is insufficient. rpx scales dimensions but does not choose a new layout.
